title: Polypiler toolchain lock
description: tooling/toolchains.lock, written in YAML: the one place an exact toolchain version is pinned. The loader also requires the keys in ordinal order, each at most once, a group 'version' in every versionPattern, the 26 core keys (for 'toolchains validate') and a host that is not itself a package for every package.

version.description: The exact version: compared by ordinal equality, never as a range or a prefix.

probe.description: The command line that prints the version; the first element is resolved on PATH or from 'home'. For kind 'nuget' the one element is the package id.

versionPattern.description: A .NET regular expression with a named group 'version', matched against each line the probe prints, standard output first.

licence.description: The SPDX identifier or expression of the toolchain's licence.

home.description: An environment variable naming an install folder, searched (and its bin folder) instead of PATH when set.

oracleOnly.description: Used only as a reference, never to build outputs.

kind.description: tool (default): an executable with a version command; package: a library inside the host named by 'requires', probed by a command; nuget: a NuGet package found in the global packages folder; external: not installable on a hosted runner.

requires.description: The key of the host toolchain of a package.

roots.description: Environment variables naming folders the toolchain reads besides its install root; the sandboxed runner shows each one that is set read-only.
